The '''trugut''' was a [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] [[Currency/Legends|currency]] used in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the last [[Time/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At that time, a single trugut's worth fluctuated near ten [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|standard credits]].

A trugut was equal to sixteen [[Wupiupi/Legends|wupiupi]] and four truguts equaled one [[Peggat/Legends|peggat]].
